QUEUE_CHANGED: A player in front of you left the player slot queue. Your new position is {Position}.
QUEUE_CHANGED_VIP: A VIP player joined the player slot queue in front of you. Your new position is {Position}.
PRIORITY_QUEUE_CHANGED: A player in front of you left the reserved slot queue. Your new position in the reserved slot queue is {Position}.
PRIORITY_QUEUE_CHANGED_VIP: A VIP player joined the reserved slot queue in front of you. Your new position in the reserved slot queue is {Position}.
QUEUE_ADDED: You joined the player slot queue! Your current position is {Position}. To leave the queue enter !rr_dequeue into the chat.
PRIORITY_QUEUE_ADDED: You joined the reserved slot queue! Your current position is {Position}. To leave the queue enter !rr_dequeue into the chat.
QUEUE_POSITION: Your current position in the player slot queue is {Position}.
PRIORITY_QUEUE_POSITION: Your current position in the reserved slot queue is {Position}.
QUEUE_POSITION_UNKNOWN: You haven't joined the player slot queue yet!
DEQUEUE_SUCCESS: You left the player slot queue!
DEQUEUE_FAILED: You are not in the player slot queue!
QUEUE_LEAVE: A player slot became available. You now get moved to the Ready Room! Thanks for waiting.
ENQUEUE_ERROR_PLAYER: Only spectators can queue for a player slot!
QUEUE_INFORM: If you want to play please press F4 or enter !rr_enqueue into the chat. Currently {Position} {Position:Pluralise:player is|players are} waiting for a player slot!
QUEUE_WELCOME_BACK: Welcome back! We restored your previous player slot queue position ({Position}). To leave the queue enter !rr_dequeue into the chat.
QUEUE_WAITTIME: Average queue time is {Time:Duration}. You may want to consider seeding an empty server.
RR_GRACE_WARNING: Players are waiting for a player slot. Join a team within {Time:Duration} or your slot will be given to the next player in the queue.
RR_GRACE_EXPIRED: Your player slot was given to a player waiting in the queue. You are now using a spectator slot.
SEED_PREF_DESCRIPTION: When you wait in a full server's queue, queued players from several servers can be moved together to seed an empty server. Choose whether you want to be asked, always join or never join.
SEED_PREF_ASK: Queued players from several servers can be moved together to seed an empty server. You will be asked first. To change this enter !seedpref always or !seedpref never into the chat, or use the vote menu.
SEED_OFFER: {Count} queued players can seed {Name} (ping {Ping}). Join them? Use the vote menu or enter !seed yes or !seed no.
SEED_ACCEPTED: You accepted the seed. You will be connected once enough players have accepted.
SEED_DECLINED: You declined the seed and keep your place in the queue.
SEED_ABORT: The seed did not go ahead. You keep your place in the queue.
SEED_NO_OFFER: There is no seed offer to answer right now.
